name: fs_write_file
description: This tool allows you to create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file on the local filesystem with the provided UTF-8 content. Use with caution: overwriting is not reversible and there is no automatic backup. Parent directories are created automatically when create_dirs is true. Access is restricted to the directories the server was launched with, and writes outside the sandbox fail with a permission error.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to write.

content.description: Full new content of the file. The previous content is discarded entirely.

create_dirs.description: Create missing parent directories instead of failing.
